confirm.title: Make a faster copy of m?
lines: Makes a faster copy. The original stays.
Changes only the output layer, the last step that picks each next word. The copy's answers are checked against the original's, then its speed.
Takes about 18 minutes (an estimate), using the GPU the whole time.
Needs up to 12.1 GB of free disk space for the copy.

parts.label: Speed up: the draft layer
parts.helper: Shrinks the guess-ahead layer, 25 to 102 min

confirm.title: Make a faster copy of m?
lines: Makes a faster copy. The original stays.
Changes only the draft layer, which guesses a few words ahead for the model to check (MTP). The model checks every guess, so only the speed with drafts on is measured.
Takes about 25 to 102 minutes (an estimate), using the GPU the whole time.
The speed with drafts on is timed on the original, the copy and the original again, once for each number of drafts it tries; how many it tries decides where in that range it ends.
Needs up to 12.1 GB of free disk space for the copy.
